prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic instrumental track featuring a prominent electric guitar melody over a driving rhythm section of bass and drums, complemented by synth pads and keyboard. The music has a bright, positive, and slightly retro feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的纯音乐曲目，以突出的电吉他旋律为主，搭配贝斯和鼓组成的强劲节奏部分，并辅以合成器铺垫和键盘音色。音乐整体感觉明亮、积极，略带复古风情。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
